```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(mgcv)     
library(plotly)
#install.packages("plotly")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
df_raw <- read_csv("../data/wonder_opioid/Five-Year-Age-Group.csv", show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA", "Not Applicable", "Suppressed")) |>
  clean_names() |>
  filter(!is.na(year))  

#names(df_raw)
#glimpse(df_raw)

df_year <- df_raw |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    age_groups = five_year_age_groups
  )

# Convert age_groups to numeric age midpoint
df_year <- df_year |>
  mutate(
    age_lo = case_when(
      age_groups == "< 1 year" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(str_extract(age_groups, "^\\d+"))
    ),
    age_hi = case_when(
      age_groups == "< 1 year" ~ 0,
      str_detect(age_groups, "\\+") ~ age_lo + 9,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(str_extract(age_groups, "(?<=-)\\d+"))
    ),
    age = (age_lo + age_hi) / 2,
    mortality = deaths / population
  ) |>
  drop_na(age, deaths)

# Filter ages 20-60
df1 <- df_year |>
  filter(age >= 20, age <= 60)

df1 <- df1 |>
  mutate(log_rate = log(mortality))

fit <- gam(
  log_rate ~ s(age, k = 4) + s(year, k = 6),
  data = df1,
  method = "REML"
)
```

```{r}
summary(fit)
```


```{r}
# Not 3d
grid <- expand_grid(
  age  = sort(unique(df1$age)),
  year = sort(unique(df1$year))
)

grid$u_hat <- predict(fit, newdata = grid)
grid$y_hat <- exp(grid$u_hat)

grid |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = y_hat, group = year)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Smoothed log mortality rate")
```

```{r}
#yrs_keep <- sort(unique(grid$year))
#yrs_keep <- yrs_keep[seq(1, length(yrs_keep), length.out = 10)] |> round()

yrs_keep <- seq(2000, 2025, by = 1)

pdat <- grid |> filter(year %in% yrs_keep)

age_fine <- seq(25, 60, by = 1)

#age_fine <- seq(min(pdat$age), max(pdat$age), by = 1)

grid_fine <- expand_grid(
  year = yrs_keep,
  age  = age_fine
)

## M_{x,t}
grid_fine$y_hat <- (predict(fit, newdata = grid_fine))

plot_ly() |>
  add_trace(
    data = grid_fine,
    x = ~age, y = ~year, z = ~y_hat,
    type = "scatter3d", mode = "lines",
    split = ~year, line = list(width = 5), opacity = 0.85
) |>
  layout(
  title = list(text = "Opioid Mortality Distribution", x = 0.5, y = 0.95),
  scene = list(
    camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.6, y = 1.6, z = 1.1), up  = list(x = 0, y = 0, z = 1)),
    uirevision = TRUE,
    domain = list(y = c(0.09, 1)),
    xaxis = list(title = "Age", autorange = "reversed"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Time (Year)", autorange = "reversed"),
    zaxis = list(title = "Smoothed Log Mortality U(x,t)") ),
  legend = list(title = list(text = "Year"), orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = 0.08, yanchor = "top", font = list(size = 8), itemsizing = "constant", entrywidth = 20, entrywidthmode = "pixels", tracegroupgap = 0),
  margin = list(b = 30, r = 60, t = 0)
)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
zmat <- grid_fine |>
  select(year, age, y_hat) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = age, values_from = y_hat) |>
  arrange(year)

x_time  <- zmat$year
y_age <- as.numeric(colnames(zmat)[-1])
z      <- as.matrix(zmat |> select(-year))

draw_surface <- function(theta = theta, phi = phi, expand = 1) {

  pmat <- persp(
    x = x_time, y = y_age, z = z,
    xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "",
    theta = theta, phi = phi, expand = expand,
    shade = 0.4, col = "gray85",
    ltheta = 120, ticktype = "detailed",
    axes = FALSE, box = TRUE
  )

  z0 <- min(z); z1 <- max(z)
  x0 <- min(x_time); x1 <- max(x_time)
  y0 <- min(y_age); y1 <- max(y_age)
  
  tick_len <- 0.05 * (z1 - z0)   # longer tick marks
  
  p1 <- trans3d(min(x_time), max(y_age), z0, pmat)
  p2 <- trans3d(max(x_time), max(y_age), z0, pmat)
  segments(p1$x, p1$y, p2$x, p2$y, lwd = 2)

  time_ticks <- seq(min(x_time), max(x_time), by = 5)
  for (tt in time_ticks) {
    a <- trans3d(tt, max(y_age), z0, pmat)
    b <- trans3d(tt, max(y_age), z0 + tick_len, pmat)
    segments(a$x, a$y, b$x, b$y)
    text(a$x, a$y, tt, pos = 1, cex = 1.0, xpd = NA)
  }

lab_time <- trans3d(mean(x_time), max(y_age), z0, pmat)
text(lab_time$x, lab_time$y, "Time (Year)", font = 2, cex = 1.2, pos = 4)

q1 <- trans3d(max(x_time), min(y_age), z0, pmat)
q2 <- trans3d(max(x_time), max(y_age), z0, pmat)
segments(q1$x, q1$y, q2$x, q2$y, lwd = 2)

  age_ticks <- seq(20, 60, by = 10)
  for (ag in age_ticks) {
    a <- trans3d(max(x_time), ag, z0, pmat)
    b <- trans3d(max(x_time), ag, z0 + tick_len, pmat)
    segments(a$x, a$y, b$x, b$y)
    text(a$x, a$y, ag, pos = 1, cex = 1.0, xpd = NA)
  }

  lab_age <- trans3d(max(x_time), mean(y_age) , z0, pmat)
  text(lab_age$x, lab_age$y, "Age", font = 2, cex = 1.2, pos = 1, xpd = NA)
  
  lab_z <- trans3d(min(x_time), min(y_age), max(z), pmat)
  text(lab_z$x, lab_z$y, "Smoothed Mortality u(x,t)", font = 2, cex = 1.2, pos = 1)
}

draw_surface(theta = 320, phi = 5)
```
